description: Discord channel management. Actions: create, edit, delete, list, permissions. Handles text, voice, categories, forums, stages.

action.description: Action: create, edit, delete, list, or permissions.

allow.description: Permission flags to allow, comma-separated (permissions). E.g. "SEND_MESSAGES,VIEW_CHANNEL".

bitrate.description: Voice bitrate in bps (voice channels, create/edit).

channel.description: Channel name or ID (required for edit/delete/permissions).

deny.description: Permission flags to deny, comma-separated (permissions). E.g. "SEND_MESSAGES".

guild_id.description: Guild ID. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID env var.

parent.description: Parent category name or ID (create/edit). Empty string to remove.

target.description: Role or user name/ID (permissions action). Use "type:role" or "type:user" prefix, or bare name/ID.

type.description: Channel type (create only, default: text). Use "category" for channel categories.

name: discord_channel
